observations: Photo 0 and photo 1: the open end of a shipping container on a truck, packed on three wooden shelves with dozens of used car engines.
Most engines in view are V6 engines with black timing covers, shown with flywheels or flexplates; some upper rows are only partly visible.
A man in a red shirt stands on the truck marking the engines with a pen; some engines carry handwritten numbers.
No brand logo, engine code stamp or label is readable on any engine in either photo.
Both photos carry a dealer watermark, and both show the same lot from slightly different angles.
No single engine is singled out as the one for sale; nothing shows any engine running.
Engines are bare long blocks with some ancillaries; sawdust on the container floor, surface grime and some rust on flywheels.

identity.kind: used V6 car engine, one unit from a container lot

claims.claim: Fits 2008-2015 Lexus RX350, ES350, IS250 and Toyota Camry
claims.evidence: No engine code is readable in either photo, and the list mixes different engines (IS250 and a four-cylinder Camry do not share the RX350 engine), so which engine is on offer is unclear.
The photos show a container of imported engines but nothing ties it to Belgium; a bill of lading would be needed.
No running clip for any engine.
A loose engine carries no odometer.
Seals and bolt heads of a specific engine are not shown close up.

risks.risk: Which engine is for sale is unknown; the lot mixes engines and the listed fitments need different engine codes.
risks.proof: Close photo of the stamped engine code on the specific engine offered, with a handwritten code and today's date on it.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced; the engine code is needed

risks.risk: Engine does not run, knocks, or has low compression.
risks.proof: Clip of that engine started on a stand, running and revving with no knock.

risks.risk: Engine has been opened or rebuilt, or parts swapped.
risks.proof: Close photos of the head and sump seals and bolt heads on the offered unit.

risks.risk: Missing ancillaries on the unit offered.
risks.proof: Photos of all four sides of the offered engine.

proof_requests: Close photo of the engine code stamped on the block of the exact engine offered, with a handwritten code and today's date on it.
Clip of that engine running on a stand with no knock.
Photos of all four sides of that engine showing what is included.
response.reason: The photos show a container full of used V6 engines, not the one unit on offer, and no engine code is readable while the listed fitments span different engines; the engine code of the specific unit is needed before even a worst case price can be set.
